summary: Tested COMM-04 campaign vendor bills (backend + UI), LN-040 real OCR GRN flow (backend), LN-043 makloon material ledger (backend + UI desktop/mobile), and the LN-043 issue_step regression. All provided test files pass: test_comm04_campaign_bills (3/3), test_l04_ln040_real_ocr (1/1, real OpenAI call about 13s), test_l04_ln043_material_ledger (3/3), test_p05_acceptance_acc31_33_34 (17/17), test_l00_p05_open_issues (5/5), test_comm04_idempotency (5/5), test_comm04_ln042t03_regression (17/17). I added a new edge test file, test_comm04_campaign_bills_edge.py: 2 of its 4 tests FAIL. sales_admin can APPROVE (this posts the 6-4700/2-1100 journal) or REJECT a campaign bill through the generic /api/vendor-bills/{id}/approve and /reject endpoints, which bypasses BILL_APPROVER_ROLES and the min-5-character reject reason. The concurrent approve test passed (exactly 1 journal entry, one 200). UI campaign bills: manager creates bills in the nested modal with no page reload; status shows 'Menunggu persetujuan'; the breakdown shows the pending amount; the creator sees no approve/reject buttons. Admin approves → 'Disetujui · belum dibayar', REALISASI 0→400.000 (excl. PPN), SISA 1.600.000. Reject with a short reason keeps the modal open; a valid reason gives 'Ditolak/batal'. LN-043 UI: MKO-00001 (Cipta Sandang) and MKO-00004 (Sukacita) show all mko-ledger-* tiles, 'Seimbang', stock line and explain list. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow (cancelled MKO-00007 shows returned 1,31 / lost 98,69, Seimbang). restore_local_demo.sh was started at the end.

critical.issue: Role/SoD bypass. A campaign bill has required_approval_role='finance'. role_satisfies is rank-based (sales_admin rank 2 == finance rank 2), so salesadmin@ gets 200: the bill is posted with the 6-4700/2-1100 journal (approve) or cancelled with an empty reason (reject). The generic endpoints use only current_user, with no vendor_bill.approve permission check, and they skip the campaign rules (BILL_APPROVER_ROLES finance/manager/admin, reason >=5). Repro: tests/test_comm04_campaign_bills_edge.py::test_generic_approve_by_sales_admin_blocked / test_generic_reject_by_sales_admin_blocked.

minor.issue: All <500 responses are cached, including 4xx (e.g. a 409 business-rule rejection on /api/goods-receipts/*/rolls). useIntentKey reuses the same key while the body is unchanged, so after the user fixes the cause elsewhere (e.g. frees bin capacity) and retries the same roll, they get the stale cached 409 for up to 7 days until the payload changes. Consider caching only 2xx, or making useIntentKey rotate the key after a 4xx.

(order.costing or {}).get('steps',[{}])[-1] raises IndexError if costing.steps is an empty list on a completed/partial order. Also, consumed uses `consumed_qty or fallback`, so a legitimate 0 falls through to the computed value.
The supplier lookup is not entity-scoped (find by id only), so a supplier from another entity can be posted through the API. vendor-options does scope the list. Low risk.

issues: With a reason under 5 chars the submit does nothing visible; no inline error/hint was found (the modal just stays open). Add a helper text or a disabled state.
The floating 'Bantuan' help FAB overlaps the end of the explain lines in mko-ledger-explain.
For a fully issued order it says 'Dicadangkan 0 kg (belum keluar gudang; fisik tidak berkurang)', which is slightly confusing; skip that line when active=0 and consumed_by_issue>0.

action_items: HIGH: Block the generic /api/vendor-bills/{id}/approve and /reject for bill_type=='campaign_expense' (delegate to mcost.approve_campaign_bill / reject_campaign_bill, or return 409/403). Or add require_permission('vendor_bill','approve') plus a role allow-list there, so sales_admin (rank==finance) can no longer approve or reject.
Idempotency: don't cache 4xx business rejections (or rotate the intent key after a 4xx in useIntentKey) so a retry after fixing the cause isn't stuck on a stale 409.
Guard IndexError in makloon_material_ledger final_output when costing.steps is an empty list.
Minor UX: show an inline validation message in mkt-bill-reject-modal for reasons under 5 chars; fix the help FAB overlapping the ledger on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: approve_campaign_bill ignores the update_one result before calling _post_bill. The concurrency test showed only 1 journal entry (_post_bill guards it), but checking matched_count would be clearer.
Campaign bill SoD depends on created_by_id. Generic endpoints only check SoD when created_by_id is set (ok here), but they do not check the role list.

success_rate.backend: 96% (49/51 incl. new edge tests; 2 failures = generic endpoint bypass)
